located_point.method: Wikidata starting point kept; its stated precision is one arcminute (about 1.8 km), and no mound could be distinguished among the fields, canals and farmsteads of the 2.5 km composite crop. No plan was available to locate the site.

sources.result: No line measured. The crop shows irrigated fields, a canal, roads and farmsteads; the small site could not be located.

notes: Not measurable. Held sources checked: Indian Archaeology - A Review 1993-94 (PDF pp. 53-58), 1994-95 (PDF pp. 33-36), 1995-96 (PDF pp. 31-33) and 1996-97 (PDF pp. 234-241, radiocarbon dates); all give text and tables only. The infrastructure's web search (optional-plan-search-v1.json) found no plan.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan found: no held or openly available plan of Harappan straight architecture at Kunal. Features not resolvable at 10 m: the site could not be located in the imagery from a one-arcminute starting point.
plan_search: No plan of Harappan architecture with a north arrow found in held sources or the infrastructure's search (21 October 2026).
